card.text: M41 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 715 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_2287: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 715.05680547 pc (16th to 84th percentile 715 to 716)

sources.quote: Messier 41 (also known as M41 or NGC 2287) is an open cluster in the constellation Canis Major.

introduction.text: M41 is drawn as 593 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.

sources.quote: Located approximately four degrees south of Sirius, it forms a roughly equilateral triangle with Sirius and Nu2 Canis Majoris, visible together in binoculars.
